sources.note: Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, 'Vermont Justices of the Peace' listing (updated December 4, 2025): lists five Maidstone justices of the peace elected November 5, 2024: Andre A. Champagne-Willis, Bruce Hobaugh, Cheryl McVetty, Heather Monahan, and Laurie-Anne Snowman. The listing publishes no vote totals or party labels and none are recorded. Bruce Hobaugh is not minted: the Town of Maidstone's Town Officials Chart (updated April 20, 2026) lists only four sitting justices and one vacant seat and does not name him, so no person or membership is created for him and the four verified winners are recorded here
Town of Maidstone (official website), Town Officials Chart (updated April 20, 2026): lists one justice of the peace seat VACANT and does not name Bruce Hobaugh
